description:
Improves the traffic light phase editor at crossings:
- Move phases up and down instead of deleting and re-adding them
- Insert a new phase directly below any existing phase
- Rename phases; the name is shown in the phase list
- Duration and Min. Duration use whole-number input fields with +1/-1 buttons instead of sliders

Known limitation: phase names are not kept when you save and reload a game; they reset to the default "Phase #n". Phase order, durations and all other settings are saved normally, since they use the game's own traffic light data.
name: Traffic Light UI enhancer
summary: Reorder, insert and rename traffic light phases, and set durations with exact whole-number inputs.
